generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Turns the requirement contract into technical themes, source families, queries, time horizons, counter-signals, diversity goals, and coverage targets.

contract.purpose_user_function: Convert a research need into a literature-discovery mode, query/topic, anchors, venues, recency/ranking logic, and evidence coverage expectations.
contract.valid_inputs: Topic or query, optional anchor papers, wiki/venue mode, year/limit parameters, evidence profile, counter-evidence needs, and provider availability.
contract.expected_outputs: A discovery request/strategy and ranked candidate set with channel, score, rationale, dedup and fetch status.
contract.state_side_effects: May contact configured literature providers and writes discovery/evidence artifacts.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Returns failed or inconclusive when the request is invalid, provider access fails, or coverage cannot be established; fixture fallback may be used.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Implements literature search strategy; source-family, geography, viewpoint, and general open-web strategy are not all first-class.
contract.success_evidence: `harness/plugins/autosci/backends/literature_discover.py::discover_literature` accepts supported modes and emits candidates conforming to `harness/schemas/evidence/literature_discovery.v1.schema.json`.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: Test topic, query, anchor recommendation, citation/reference expansion, venue/wiki, recency/limit, counter-evidence request, provider failure, and offline fallback.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md#Appendix: AutoSci Commands (`/discover`, `/research`, `/survey`); docs/integrations/autosci/full-parity-progress-report.md#Remaining Partial/Gated Routes documents incomplete global parity, provider-gated routes, and remaining semantic-proof gaps.
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: skills/discover/SKILL.md; harness/plugins/autosci/bin/autosci_bridge.py discovery action; README.md#Appendix: AutoSci Commands
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Networked discovery depends on configured providers and credentials; fixture fallback can be inconclusive. Current discovery is literature-centric rather than a complete multi-source intelligence system. README.md#Platform Support states macOS is primary, Linux supported, and Windows/WSL2 experimental; live provider authentication, trust, network, quota, and approval boundaries still apply.
